Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 25,000eb - 5 Months

This model of Sandevistan doesn't exist, at least officially. Off the record, there's gossip of secret Militech Lunar labs producing covert cyberware. It was never meant to be mass produced, but an army would only need a few pieces like this to dominate their enemy.

Iconic Sandevistan Operating System. The Sandevistan now requires an additional Neuralware Option Slot and counts as an installation of Borgware for the purposes of Max Humanity Loss, and every time a Non-FBC user without a Cyberspine activates it, they suffer 1d6 Humanity Loss.

The Sandevistan can now be activated without an Action, its Initiative Bonus is increased by 3 (+6), and its duration is reduced to 9 seconds (3 Rounds). While active, the user can dodge Ranged Attacks regardless of their REF (if they could not already), ignores all penalties they’d suffer to MOVE and Evasion Checks, and gain a +2 bonus to Aimed Shots.

If the user is a Solo, then while Sandevistan is active, whenever they make an Aimed Shot, use a weapon’s Alternate Firing Mode, or make a Martial Arts Special Move Resolution, they may also immediately reassign their Combat Awareness Points without an Action.

The Sandevistan cannot be activated again for 60 seconds (20 Rounds) unless the user voluntarily suffers 3 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation before a minute passes (e.g., 3 -> 6 -> 9, etc).

Fabrication: DV29 - 25,000eb - 5 Months
Enhances: Sandevistan
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Change the Sandevistan's initiative effect to +6 while this OS is installed.
  • The extra Option Slot it consumes, and the Borgware it counts as, are applied by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
